home.title: EFP Apps
home.heading: Apps are opened from the Portal
home.message: Find the app you are looking for in the Portal and open it from there.

starting.title: Starting {app}
starting.heading: {app} is starting
starting.message: This usually takes a few seconds. The page reloads by itself.

unavailable.title: {app} is not available
unavailable.heading: {app} is not available right now
unavailable.message: The app is stopped or cannot be reached at the moment. Try again shortly.

not_deployed.title: {app} is not deployed
not_deployed.heading: {app} has not been deployed yet
not_deployed.message: Its owner, {owner}, has not deployed it yet. Come back later.
not_deployed.message_no_owner: Its owner has not deployed it yet. Come back later.

crashed.title: {app} stopped
crashed.heading: {app} stopped unexpectedly
crashed.message: The app ran into an error and is not running. Its owner, {owner}, can find the cause in the app's logs in the Portal.
crashed.message_no_owner: The app ran into an error and is not running. Its owner can find the cause in the app's logs in the Portal.

no_access.title: No access
no_access.heading: You do not have access to {app}
no_access.message: Ask its owner, {owner}, to share it with you.
no_access.message_no_owner: Ask its owner to share it with you.

disabled.title: {app} was taken down
disabled.heading: {app} has been taken down
disabled.message: This app cannot be opened any more.

not_found.title: App not found
not_found.heading: There is no app at this address
not_found.message: Check the link, or look for the app in the Portal.

signin_failed.title: Sign-in did not finish
signin_failed.heading: Sign-in did not finish
signin_failed.message: The sign-in link has expired or was already used. Open the app again to sign in.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.heading: Too many requests
rate_limited.message: Wait a moment and try again.
